The Twinkle Star Climax came to a close 
amidst immense excitement.

The entire crowd cheers for the moment <chrname> 
became the "strongest"...!

Reporter Otonashi offered grand 
congratulations once again, accompanied by 
an enthusiastic interview!

The proof of <chrname>'s strength is always shining 
brilliantly.

"Let's keep aiming for even greater 
heights together." That was the vow the 
two of them made...!
